preToolUse.powershell: foreach ($r in @('.', 'prototype')) { $py = Join-Path $r '.venv\Scripts\python.exe'; $h = Join-Path $r 'hooks\render_template.py'; if ((Test-Path $py) -and (Test-Path $h)) { & $py $h --protocol copilot; break } }; exit 0
preToolUse.bash: for r in . prototype; do for p in "$r/.venv/bin/python" "$r/.venv/Scripts/python.exe"; do h="$r/hooks/render_template.py"; if [ -x "$p" ] && [ -f "$h" ]; then "$p" "$h" --protocol copilot; exit 0; fi; done; done; exit 0
